articles.title: Thailand-Cambodia fighting enters 5th day, Thai PM confirms Trump call
articles.summary: The border conflict between Cambodia and Thailand has escalated, entering its fifth day with continued fighting. Cambodia accuses the Thai military of shelling its territory, while Thailand's caretaker Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has confirmed details, suggesting ongoing bilateral tension and military engagement. This prolonged dispute highlights regional instability and ongoing cross-border hostilities.

articles.title: 8-hour op, multiple agencies, continuous monitoring over 7 months: How the leopard seen at Pune airport was captured
articles.summary: A leopard, repeatedly spotted at Pune International Airport, was captured Friday morning after an intensive eight-hour multi-agency operation throughout the night. Forest department officials, police, and airport staff collaborated to safely tranquilize and remove the animal. This swift, coordinated effort secured airport safety and prevented operational disruption, demonstrating effective inter-agency response.
